title: Restoration step on empty history
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine on input $x$, and let $p$ be a valid input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions. Starting the restoration machine at the checkpoint for $c$ with empty history, one step gives the completed restoration configuration for $c$ and $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine on input $x$
$p$ is a valid input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions
replaced:
With no history left, one silent step of the restoration machine from the
checkpoint for a source configuration $c$ with empty history returns the history
heads to zero and halts, reaching the completed restoration configuration for
$c$. This also covers a source run of zero steps.
